label: Skeptical suspension of judgment in…: The procedure ends without accepting or rejecting the…
term: skeptical suspension of judgment in the Five Modes
definition: The procedure ends without accepting or rejecting the investigated matter when the described dispute or establishing procedure has not supplied a verdict. Suspension is not an asserted negation of the matter and does not by itself supply a positive knowledge claim.
note: Scope is the selected PHI165–169 passage. This does not settle every interpretive question about Sextus’ broader skeptical practice.
